description: This Java source file defines the Variance class within the org.apache.commons.math3.stat.descriptive.moment package. The class computes statistical variance using incremental and full-array methods, supporting bias correction and weighted calculations. It includes multiple constructors, standard statistical methods, and internal state management. The file depends on several other classes such as SecondMoment, Mean, and various exceptions.

classes.name: Variance
classes.description: Implements calculation of variance for a dataset, supporting incremental updates, full array evaluation, weighted calculations, and bias correction options.

methods.name: increment
methods.description: Adds a new value to the dataset, updating internal calculations if incrementing is enabled.

methods.name: getResult
methods.description: Returns the current variance based on the internal state, considering bias correction.

methods.name: evaluate
methods.description: Computes and returns the variance of a given array or subarray, optionally using weighted values, without modifying internal state.

methods.name: clear
methods.description: Resets the internal state of the variance calculator.

methods.name: copy
methods.description: Creates a deep copy of the Variance object.
